name: francis-overlay-shell
author: Ap3pp3rs94
description: Electron desktop overlay shell for the Francis HUD

scripts.overlay:test: node --test electron/accessibility.test.cjs electron/authority-posture.test.cjs electron/lifecycle-history.test.cjs electron/provider-posture.test.cjs electron/signing-posture.test.cjs electron/signature-state.test.cjs electron/builder-config.test.cjs electron/preferences.test.cjs electron/session-state.test.cjs electron/login-item.test.cjs electron/startup-profile.test.cjs electron/orb-behavior.test.cjs electron/build-info.test.cjs electron/build-provenance.test.cjs electron/update-state.test.cjs electron/update-delivery.test.cjs electron/update-repair.test.cjs electron/state-migrations.test.cjs electron/state-repair.test.cjs electron/degraded-mode.test.cjs electron/overlay-portability.test.cjs electron/retained-state.test.cjs electron/preflight.test.cjs electron/backup-state.test.cjs electron/decommission-plan.test.cjs electron/support-state.test.cjs electron/support-bundle.test.cjs electron/python-runtime.test.cjs electron/hud-runtime.test.cjs electron/orb-surface.test.cjs electron/orb-perception.test.cjs electron/foreground-window.test.cjs electron/windows-input.test.cjs electron/orb-authority.test.cjs electron/orb-plan.test.cjs
scripts.overlay:pack: npm run overlay:prepare-runtime && npm run overlay:prepare-provenance && electron-builder --config electron/builder-config.cjs --dir --win && npm run overlay:verify-signing
scripts.overlay:pack:signed: npm run overlay:prepare-runtime && npm run overlay:prepare-provenance && electron-builder --config electron/builder-config.cjs --dir --win && npm run overlay:verify-signing:required
scripts.overlay:installer: npm run overlay:prepare-runtime && npm run overlay:prepare-provenance && electron-builder --config electron/builder-config.cjs --win nsis && npm run overlay:verify-signing
scripts.overlay:installer:signed: npm run overlay:prepare-runtime && npm run overlay:prepare-provenance && electron-builder --config electron/builder-config.cjs --win nsis && npm run overlay:verify-signing:required
scripts.overlay:dist: npm run overlay:prepare-runtime && npm run overlay:prepare-provenance && electron-builder --config electron/builder-config.cjs --win portable nsis && npm run overlay:verify-signing
scripts.overlay:dist:signed: npm run overlay:prepare-runtime && npm run overlay:prepare-provenance && electron-builder --config electron/builder-config.cjs --win portable nsis && npm run overlay:verify-signing:required
scripts.release:publish:windows: npm run release:hardening && npm run overlay:dist:signed
